name: verify
description: Verification procedures. Each skill runs one published protocol to produce evidence about code that already exists, rather than an argument about it. Ships /repro (delta debugging), /bisect (predicate-driven bisection), /boundary (equivalence partitioning and boundary value analysis), /differential (differential testing), /property (property-based testing), /mutate (mutation testing), and /characterize (Feathers characterization testing). All are manual except /characterize, /differential, and /mutate, which /hub can run as steps. Three skills bundle a zero-dependency Node script, and /mutate, the only skill that rewrites a tracked file, refuses to run on a dirty tree or a red suite and proves byte-identical restoration.
